name: Generic pickup truck
description: Generic pickup truck (crew cab, short bed). LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 groups under the root; four wheel groups outside the LODs. Materials: Paint, Trim, Glass, Chrome, Tyre, Rim, Headlight, Taillight, BrakeLight, Plate. No interior, no text or logos.
brief: Generic unbranded crew-cab short-bed pickup truck for Golden Gate web-scene traffic, viewed from about 3 m to 1 km. About 5.90 x 2.03 x 1.95 m, wheelbase about 3.70 m. Frame: metres, +Y up, +X forward, right side at +Z, origin at ground level centred between axles. Wheel groups Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR pivot at the wheel centre with the axle along Z; LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 child groups (12k/3k/600 triangle budgets). Paint is untinted near-white so the scene can tint it.
